instruction_prefix: Correct the grammar in this sentence:

stage1.data: cleaned C4-200M sample: 1,150,000 training pairs + 172,500 no-edit (target->target) pairs = 1,322,500 examples
stage1.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation loss, evaluated every 2,500 steps and at the last step (25,000-pair synthetic validation split)
stage1.loss_normalisation_check: training stops if mean recent training loss / validation loss > 2.0 at the first evaluation

stage2.data: W&I+LOCNESS v2.1 training M2 files A, B and C (first annotator): 34,308 pairs from 3,000 essays
stage2.holdout: 5% of the essays of each band (seed 42): 150 essays, 1,623 pairs; training pairs whose source occurs in a held-out essay removed (371): 32,314 training pairs
stage2.checkpoint_selection: lowest holdout loss, evaluated at each epoch end
stage2.budget_curve: nested 25% / 50% of the training essays per band: 8,094 / 16,271 pairs (seed 42)

decoding.refinement: re-run the model on its own output; accept the second output only if it changes at most 3 tokens
decoding.threshold: revert the whole sentence to the source when mean log p(output) - mean log p(source) < tau
decoding.tau_selection: maximise edit-level F0.5 on the stage-2 holdout

retokenisation_for_scoring.conll: rule-based tokenizer (analysis/retok.py: regex_tok), 99.3% round-trip on CoNLL-2014 references
retokenisation_for_scoring.bea: spaCy en_core_web_sm tokenizer (analysis/retok.py: spacy_tok), 98.7% round-trip on BEA-2019 references

primary_system: identity pairs + stage 1 + stage 2 (essay-level split) + beam/length penalty 0.7 + refinement + holdout-tuned threshold
